meta.title: Hygge Home — Partner credentials 2027
meta.description: Credentials deck for Hygge Home, a Copenhagen maker of furniture and lighting, for hotels and retail partners: point of view, three design rules, three projects with results, partners, and how a partner floor opens.

slides.heading: Rooms that feel finished, built to last twenty years.
slides.lead: Furniture and lighting for hotels and home stores since 2014.
slides.notes: One sentence, then move. The room on the next slide does the talking.

slides.heading: We design the light first, then the furniture around it
